symbols.notes: The node-area comparison against the 75,000 px² cutoff is inlined here. Newer builds load the shared cutoff into an XMM register on two mutually exclusive feature paths and reuse it for the final occlusion-state write; GlassIntegrity must zero only these local loads so all three decisions remain consistent without changing the shared constant's other consumers.
